pin_regs.reason: F1 relay = ONE register stage at the pins by definition: i is captured by the stage register, o leaves it through the matched forwarding buffer; a pin register would add a cycle per hop and break the clk_out / o driver match (DIE-CLOCK F1)

structural_change: NATIVE-FIX3 rr1 (2026-10-18): rs -> ot_hbm_rly RS_RELAY=1 = registered reset relay (rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv, 2 sync + 1 relay flop) so the W-face rs pin drives 3 flops instead of the async clear of all 136 stage flops (closed hbfd_rly_136_ns_fc_f2-ff1-02fc2ee56: routed native capture rs 211.1 ps > 190, NATIVE-3). Data path, outline, pin plan (rs on W) unchanged; stage release 3 clock edges after rs (as the > 256 b classes), assert async/immediate; 0 data cycles. Was: F1 forwarded-clock FORK variant (DIE-CLOCK rule: fork = relay tile with 2 branches, each with its own kept clk_out<k> buffer off the CTS tree + matched o<k> buffers on its face); same ot_hbm_rly stage; faces N: ['i'], S: [0, 1]; outline 56.16 x 21.6 um

job.purpose: HBM die F1 forwarded-clock fork relay hbfd_rly_136_NS_fc_f2: register on clk_in, 2 branches (clk_out<k> = one kept BUFx12f from the clk_in root, o<k> through the same cell beside it); 56.16 x 21.6 um, M5 cap
